description: This file defines HomeBrowseFragment, a fragment for displaying categorized rows of workout and category items in an Android TV application using Leanback library. It includes presenter classes for workout and category cards with focus behavior, image loading via Glide, and navigation handlers.

classes.name: HomeBrowseFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays categorized sections of workout and category items for Android TV, with custom header styling, focus behavior, and preload animations.

classes.name: WorkoutCardPresenter
classes.description: Custom presenter for workout items, providing image card views with focus zoom, rounded corners, and crossfade images.

classes.name: CategoryCardPresenter
classes.description: Custom presenter for category items, similar to workout cards, with image loading and focus animations.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holders for workout or category cards, setting focus and appearance behaviors.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from WorkoutItem or CategoryItem to respective card views, loads images with Glide.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Performs cleanup when view holders are unbound (no-op in this implementation).
